confirmed_findings: The passphrase field in the redfish_certificate resource schema (resource_certificate.go:106-115) is missing the Sensitive: true attribute, causing Terraform to render the passphrase value in plaintext in plan/apply output instead of masking it as (sensitive value).

commands.notes: All failures are pre-existing acceptance tests requiring TF_TESTING_USERNAME and real iDRAC credentials - not caused by this change

notes: Schema-only change adding Sensitive: true to the passphrase field. Acceptance tests require real iDRAC hardware and cannot be run in this environment.
